readme:
# Spotify Artist API

Fetch a Spotify artist's discography (albums, singles, top tracks) and metadata by artist URL or ID.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "spotify/artist", "url": "https://open.spotify.com/artist/3DiDSECUqqY1AuBP8qtaIa"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. Lookups that find nothing fail with a not-found error.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | No | Spotify artist ID (alternative to url). |
| `url` | string | No | Spotify artist URL (e.g. https://open.spotify.com/artist/3DiDSECUqqY1AuBP8qtaIa). |

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.0012 per request. A call can cost more when the first data source fails and another one answers. Failed calls and lookups that find nothing are not charged.
